## Description
Why LangChain on Termux? Bloat & Crash vs 94KB Zero-Dep LCEL & Hardware Native Agents.
Termux-AIChain is an ultra-lightweight, zero-external-dependency AI chaining and autonomous agent framework for Android Termux (ARM64) and Node.js 18+ ESM. Provides 100% pure standard-library LCEL pipe chaining (prompt | llm | parser), StateGraph multi-agent loops, on-device SQLite vector RAG, and native Android smartphone hardware actuation (battery, temperature, haptics, GPS).
